lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 7 — Stephen’s Speech / The Stoning of Stephen

questions.questionText: Who asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
Stephen said the God of glory appeared to me in Mesopotamia. Who am I?
Where did God tell Abraham to leave?
Where did Abraham then live?
options: Haran, and later this land where you are now living

questions.questionText: True or false: God gave Abraham no inheritance here, not even enough ground to set his foot on.
options: False — God gave him the whole city that day

questions.questionText: God said Abraham’s descendants would be strangers in a country for how many years?
God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. Who then circumcised Isaac on the eighth day?
The patriarchs were jealous of me and sold me into Egypt. Who am I?
Who was with Joseph and rescued him from all his troubles?
I made Joseph ruler over Egypt and my entire palace. Who am I?
What came over all Egypt and Canaan?
On Jacob’s second visit, how many of Joseph’s family were brought to Egypt?
Where did Jacob die, and where was he laid in the tomb?
options: He died in Egypt and was laid in the tomb in Shechem

questions.questionText: A new king who knew nothing about Joseph came to power in Egypt. What did he do to our people?
options: He oppressed them and forced them to throw out their newborn babies

questions.questionText: I was born at that time, no ordinary child. Who am I?
For how many months was Moses cared for in his father’s house?
Who took Moses and brought him up as her own son?
What was Moses educated in?
options: All the wisdom of the Egyptians

questions.questionText: When Moses was how old did he visit his own people?
What did Moses do when he saw an Israelite being mistreated?
Where did Moses flee as a stranger?
How many years later did an angel appear to Moses in the flames of a burning bush?
Where was the burning bush?
options: Near Mount Sinai, in the desert of Mount Sinai

questions.questionText: Who said, “I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob”?
What did God tell Moses to do because the place was holy?
Whom did God send back to Egypt to rescue Israel?
What did Moses do in Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness?
options: He led them out performing wonders and signs

questions.questionText: Moses told Israel God would raise up a prophet like him. Stephen quotes this to point to whom?
What did their ancestors ask Aaron to make?
options: Gods who will go before us (a calf)

questions.questionText: God turned away and gave them over to worship the sun, moon and stars, as written in which book does Stephen mention later about the tent?
options: The book of the prophets / tent of Moloch mentioned

questions.questionText: What did their ancestors have in the wilderness?
options: The tabernacle of the covenant law

questions.questionText: I asked to find a dwelling place for the God of Jacob, and my son built God a house. Who am I?
True or false: Stephen said the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands.
options: False — God only lives in Solomon’s temple
False — Stephen never spoke of God
True — God lives only in Rome

questions.questionText: Stephen said, “You stiff-necked people! … You always resist the Holy Spirit.” To whom?
Stephen said which of the prophets did their ancestors not persecute?
options: They persecuted them all / they killed those who predicted the Righteous One

questions.questionText: You have betrayed and murdered me — the Righteous One. Who am I?
How did the Sanhedrin react to Stephen’s speech?
options: They were furious and gnashed their teeth at him

questions.questionText: What did Stephen see when he was full of the Holy Spirit?
options: Heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God

questions.questionText: What did they do when they heard Stephen say that?
options: They covered their ears, yelled, dragged him out of the city and began to stone him

questions.questionText: Witnesses laid their coats at my feet. I was a young man. Who am I?
Who said, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit”?
Who said, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them”?
What happened after Stephen said that?
Where did they drag Stephen to stone him?
I stood at God’s right hand while Stephen looked up. Who am I?
How many years did Moses spend in Midian before the burning bush?
I built a house for God after David asked for a dwelling place. Who am I?
In which land was Moses born and later educated?
